Project.name: Realtime Call Translator
Project.annotation: Real-time bidirectional voice translator for video/voice calls. Translates both sides of a conversation live.
Project.keywords: realtime, stt, tts, translation, voice, wasapi, deepgram, whisper, elixir, rust, python, flask, piper

Actors.actor-User: User speaking into microphone, hearing translated output through speakers/headphones.
Actors.actor-RemotePerson: Remote participant in a conference call speaking a different language.
Actors.actor-System: Automated STT→Translate→TTS pipeline running on local machine.

UC-001.Action: Speaks in native language (e.g., Russian) into Jabra microphone
UC-001.Goal: Remote participant hears translation in their language (e.g., English) via meeting app
UC-001.Preconditions: Meeting app running, CABLE configured, Jabra connected
UC-001.AcceptanceCriteria: STT produces transcript, translation is correct, TTS plays through CABLE Input

UC-002.Action: Speaks in their language (e.g., English) in conference
UC-002.Goal: User hears translation in native language (e.g., Russian) through Jabra speakers
UC-002.Preconditions: Meeting app outputs to CABLE Input, loopback capture active
UC-002.AcceptanceCriteria: Remote audio captured via CABLE Output, translated, TTS plays through Jabra

UC-003.Action: Configures audio devices and API keys in Flask web UI
UC-003.Goal: Settings persist and pipeline uses correct devices/APIs
UC-003.AcceptanceCriteria: Settings saved to settings.json, pipeline restarts with new config

UC-004.Action: Falls back to alternative STT/translation provider on failure
UC-004.Goal: Pipeline continues working when primary provider fails
UC-004.Preconditions: Fallback provider configured with valid API key
UC-004.AcceptanceCriteria: Deepgram→Whisper fallback for STT; Groq→LiteLLM→Yandex for translation

NonGoals.item-1: No cloud deployment — runs locally on user's machine
NonGoals.item-2: No multi-user support — single user per instance
NonGoals.item-3: No browser-based STT — all processing is local or via API

Constraints.constraint-1: Must run on Windows with WASAPI audio drivers
Constraints.constraint-2: Must work with VB-Audio Virtual Cable for audio routing
Constraints.constraint-3: Python 3.12 required for Whisper STT and Flask web UI Deepgram WebSocket connections may be unstable on some networks

Risks.risk-1: Deepgram WS error 10054 every ~20-25 seconds on unstable networks
Risks.risk-2: Whisper small model produces hallucinations on short/noisy audio segments
Risks.risk-3: WASAPI COM references from list_devices() can block pipeline audio capture
Risks.risk-4: Echo feedback through CABLE if meeting app misconfigured

OpenQuestions.question-1: Should Yandex SpeechKit STT (gRPC) replace Deepgram as primary STT?
OpenQuestions.question-2: Is WASAPI loopback viable as alternative to CABLE-based incoming pipeline?
